name: Sagittarius A*
tagline: The Milky Way's central supermassive black hole — a 4.3-million-solar-mass engine anchoring the entire galaxy.

facts.label: Evidence
facts.value: S-star orbits — S2 swings by at 7,650 km/s

facts.label: Radio size
facts.value: ~52 µas ring — a doughnut seen from 27,000 ly

history: Sagittarius A* sits at the exact dynamical center of the Milky Way, deep in the Sagittarius arm. Radio astronomers pinpointed it in 1974 as a compact, variable source no bigger than a solar system. Decades of astrometry by the Genzel and Ghez teams traced the S-stars whipping around an invisible mass — S2's 16-year orbit and 7,650 km/s pericenter passage made the black hole incontrovertible, earning the 2020 Nobel Prize. In May 2022 the Event Horizon Telescope released its silhouette: a ring of superheated plasma glowing around the shadow, matching general relativity's prediction to a few percent. Though quiescent today, flares in X-ray and infrared betray an accretion flow that flickers daily; its relic jets are suspected to have inflated the Fermi bubbles — two 25,000-light-year gamma-ray lobes rising from the disc.

sections.title: The EHT silhouette
sections.body: Eight radio telescopes synced by atomic clocks formed an Earth-sized interferometer. The May 2022 image resolved a 52-microarcsecond ring — light bent into a photon orbit around the shadow — confirming the mass in a region barely larger than Mercury's orbit.

sections.title: The S-star swarm
sections.body: Dozens of young stars orbit within light-weeks of the horizon. Their Keplerian ellipses pin the mass at 4.3 million Suns; relativistic precession of S2's orbit, measured in 2020, is frame-dragging made visible.

sections.title: A sleeping giant
sections.body: Sgr A* accretes a hundred-thousandth of the Eddington rate — a whisper, not a roar. Yet ~300 years ago it flared bright enough for molecular clouds to still echo the blast, and the Fermi bubbles record an outburst millions of years ago.

source: Event Horizon Telescope · ESO · Nobel Prize 2020
